name: Ham Bands
description: The amateur radio spectrum, drawn to scale in the Omarchy bar: every band a bar at its real place, coloured by mode, with license-class privileges, powers and caveats on hover, propagation notes on click, for 15 countries.

barWidget.description: Band allocations by country and license class.

schema.label: Country
schema.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code of the allocation table to show, e.g. US, GB, DE, AU

schema.label: Your license class
schema.description: Class id from the country's table, e.g. technician, foundation, ein. Blank shows every class
